conditions_of_approval: Approved provisionally for prototype use. The dual-sided occupancy model, including Low Utilisation, Normal Operating Band, Elevated Occupancy and Critical Capacity Pressure, and the treatment of occupancy above 100 percent must be operationally validated before hospital deployment.

Approved provisionally using valid complaints per 1,000 patient encounters. Denominator accuracy and stability must be confirmed within 90 days. Thresholds must be recalibrated if the denominator methodology changes.
